lines.text: Many learners say: I ride a car to work.
Better: I drive a car to work.
Drive! My dad can drive a car.

data.wrong: I ride a car to work.
data.right: I drive a car to work.

native.tip: 한국어 “차를 타다”의 ‘타다’를 ride로 옮기기 쉬워요. 직접 운전할 땐 drive를 써요. 이렇게 말해요 👉 “I drive a car to work.”

en.tip: If you are the driver, say drive. Say “I drive a car to work.”
en.caption: Do you say it like this? 😅 “I ride a car to work.” If you are the driver, say drive. Right: “I drive a car to work.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
